title: Philips 50PUD7406/43 (TPV, PH0M_EA_T32, MStar/MediaTek), Chile, Android TV 11
header:
Philips 50PUD7406/43 (TPV, PH0M_EA_T32, MStar/MediaTek), Chile, Android TV 11
Android TV 11 (SDK 30), firmware TPM215L_R.105.000.097.000, build RTM2.210929.098
ro.product.model=2020/2021 UHD Android TV  ro.product.device=PH0M_EA_T32  ro.product.name=PH0M_LT_T32
Fingerprint: Philips/PH0M_LT_T32/PH0M_EA_T32:11/RTM2.210929.098/200321:user/release-keys
persist.odm.tpv.region=lt (Latin America). About 1.38 GB RAM, ro.config.low_ram=true.
Second unit: Europe (Denmark), retail model unknown. Same ro.product.device=PH0M_EA_T32 and build
RTM2.210929.098, but ro.product.name=PH0M_EA_T32, incremental 200715, persist.odm.tpv.region=eu.
Same RAM. On Wi-Fi. See "Second unit" below.

Same board and firmware as docs/devices/philips-65pug7406-78.md, which is launcher notes only;
this is the first debloat list for PH0M_EA_T32. It is NOT the TP Vision org.droidtv platform of
examples/philips-50pus8517 (PH1M): there is no org.droidtv.xtv/playtv here, Live TV and inputs
are MediaTek's com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter, and only a thin org.droidtv layer is present.
The About screen shows the generic "2020/2021 UHD Android TV"; read the retail model off the
sticker and match on ro.product.device and the TPM215L firmware instead.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/philips-50pud7406/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/philips-50pud7406/debloat.txt com.google.android.tvlauncher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (disabled by launcher/build-and-install.ps1).
Live TV app:    com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter
ADB: USB debugging alone opens port 5555 (ro.adb.secure=1, the RSA prompt appears on screen).

Tested: remote, Bluetooth, YouTube, Disney+, DirecTV GO and Zapping play normally, idle logcat
shows no retry loops. NOT tested yet: HDMI inputs / Source key, antenna/cable channels and
firmware updates, so org.droidtv.eum and nettvregistration below stay commented out until those are
checked (with them disabled, run the Source key, live channels and a reboot, then uncomment).

QUIRKS ON THIS FIRMWARE:

1. Screensaver. screensaver_components ships as com.google.android.backdrop/.Backdrop with a
5-minute screen_off_timeout. Once backdrop is disabled the screensaver points at a disabled
component, so set another one:
settings put secure screensaver_components com.gathin.tvhome/.ClockDream
settings put secure screensaver_default_component com.gathin.tvhome/.ClockDream
(or com.android.dreams.basic/.Colors without the launcher).
2. Chromecast on a shared network. On this owner's Wi-Fi (a large shared network, ~150 hosts
across 192.168.1-18.x) about 150 devices held connections to the TV's Cast port 8009, and
YouTube kept pausing and then closing a few minutes into a video. The log showed the exit:
ActivityTaskManager: START u0 {act=MAIN cat=[HOME] ...} from uid 10043
uid 10043 is com.google.android.apps.mediashell. Disabling it fixed playback. Unlike the
50PUS8517 (its quirk 4), mediashell stayed disabled here 45 s after disabling; a reboot
check is still pending. Keep it (comment the line out) if you cast from your phone and your
network is your own.
3. lowmemorykiller is active even at idle with one app playing ("low watermark is breached and
thrashing"); this is a 1.38 GB low_ram set, so every background service removed helps.
4. Do not open com.mediatek.tv.factory or mediatek.factorymenu.ui to see what they do (see
PROMPT.md); they are left alone.
5. Boot to Live TV (EU unit). After a full reboot, Home comes up and about 0.2 s later system_server
sends android.mtk.intent.action.ACTION_REQUEST_TOP_RESUME to
com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter/.nav.TurnkeyUiMainActivity, so the TV lands in Live TV. Neither
settings list has a switch for it. A normal power-on from standby lands on Home.

SECOND UNIT (EU, Denmark, Danish UI). Tested the same day only, not over several days. The whole
list below applied cleanly, except that the owner kept com.google.android.apps.mediashell
(Chromecast, on a home network), Netflix and Spotify. org.droidtv.android.fitness is not installed
on this unit. The owner also disabled com.google.android.katniss (Assistant). Home handed over to
launcher/ on the first try. A reboot re-enabled nothing. Real-remote checks after the reboot: Home,
Source/Input and Settings keys, the Netflix key, Back, and held volume all work. Netflix, Spotify,
YouTube and live channels play (Live TV or TiviMate; the owner did not report them separately).
Private DNS (dns.adguard-dns.com) works.
HDMI picture is still untested: nothing is plugged in. org.droidtv.eum and nettvregistration
stayed enabled on this unit too, so the Source key result does not cover disabling them.
The owner also disabled com.mediatek.wwtv.mediaplayer (MMP, the USB photo/video player).
tools/disable.sh skips it because it requests TV_INPUT_HARDWARE, but on this unit it serves no
TvInputService: `pm query-services --components -a android.media.tv.TvInputService` lists only
com.mediatek.tvinput (tuner, HDMI, composite, ...) and com.mediatek.tv.service. It is left
commented out below until someone checks an HDMI picture with it disabled.
